idempotency: Duplicate job delivery must not duplicate authoritative mutation.
models.locks: Implementation-specific locking primitives are not canonically specified by source.

Critical writes use OCC/idempotency/transaction boundaries where defined.

idempotency: Transfer protocol prevents dual residency; failed import follows deterministic replay/rollback.
models.locks: Fixed deterministic sequencing rather than nondeterministic shared-state locking.
race_requirements: Same ordered input stream must yield identical shard/tick hash.
